_comment: When multiple experts use the same base weights (e.g. Qwen2.5-7B), the base
is loaded once and adapters (LoRA) are swapped in/out per request.
This is more VRAM-efficient than loading each expert's full weights separately.
adapter_slots: max number of LoRA adapters resident simultaneously.
adapter_vram_gb: VRAM cost per loaded adapter (typically 0.1–0.5 GB for 4-bit LoRA).
base_vram_cost_gb: VRAM for the frozen base model alone (no adapters).

adapters._comment: Coding specialist adapter — routes from 'code' role.
adapters.description: Code generation, debugging, refactoring. Trained on coding traces.
